messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout for `prompt_hop_v2` paused automatically — error_rate breached threshold (0.22 > 0.08). Canary slice: 5%. Rolling logs: `500` spike on /v2/prompt/hop. Auto-rollback not configured for this rollout. Incident created: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0912

maya: Paging on-call. I'm seeing customer-reported latency + 500s for prompt-routing to the new endpoint. Canary slice at 5% started ~6m ago, error rate tripped. @pagerduty-bot can you page the oncall?

pagerduty-bot: @maya — Paging oncall (eng-sre-shift). Incident INC-2026-0912 assigned to jordan.

jordan: on-call here, looking. Thanks maya. Can someone paste the exact FF key and how to flip?

samir: FF key is `feature.prompt_hop_v2`. It's a staged rollout 5/100. To kill: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN" 
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/feature.prompt_hop_v2 -d '{"state":"off"}'`

maya: quick context: this was an experimental routing mesh that shards prompts across `prompt-hub` -> `prompt-hop` -> models for latency optimization. New endpoint `/v2/prompt/hop` returning `500` and `upstream timeout` for a subset of customers (mainly EU region).

jordan: running the curl now.

jordan: ```
# executed
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/feature.prompt_hop_v2 -d '{"state":"off"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"flag":"feature.prompt_hop_v2","state":"off","updated_by":"jordan"}
```

samir: flipping fallback routing as well — pushing traffic back to legacy `/v1/prompt` for the canary cohort. Command: `routectl promote prompt_v1 --cohort=canary`

ekaterina: Noted customer impact: two paying customers reported degraded response times and occasional 500s: AcmeAnalytics and SmartDocs. Acme saw 10-15% request failures in EU region last 8 minutes. SmartDocs trace shows `connection reset by peer` to prompt-hop.

maya: Adding quick rolling mitigation checklist: 1) kill flag (done), 2) route canary back to v1 (samir executing), 3) scaleup prompt-hop pods to investigate (if needed), 4) monitor SLOs for 15m, 5) notify customers if degradation >5m.

samir: routectl returned success: `promoted cohort canary -> prompt_v1` and `decreased traffic to prompt_hop_v2 to 0%`.

deploy-bot: Canary toggled off by jordan at 2045678929. Traffic route change detected: canary -> legacy endpoint. Metrics stream: error_rate dropping to 0.03 within 60s.

jordan: confirming metrics: EU error_rate for /v2/prompt/hop down from 0.22 -> 0.04 over last 2m. Latency back to expected baseline. Anyone see any lingering 500s in logs?

maya: I'm seeing a few stragglers but <1%. Customer callbacks indicate response quality back to normal.

ekaterina: Putting brief summary for postmortem: root cause appears to be a regression in connection handling in prompt-hop when downstream model pool scales cold — specific stacktrace in logs: `timeout while waiting for socket` around the new routing optimizer (v0.9.1). Suggests either a race in connection pool or an unhandled upstream error.

jordan: Good. Incident severity: SEV2 (customer impact, partial). Next actions: collect logs + traces (samir), create incident timeline (maya), schedule a follow-up triage with eng-runtime and eng-ml to reproduce and patch. I'm handing off to next oncall at shift change in 20m — leaving notes and monitoring alerts.

maya: I'm taking on incident owner for the follow-up and postmortem. Samir, can you dump a few example request ids for AcmeAnalytics and SmartDocs so we can attach to a bug?

samir: example ids: `req-2045678950-ACME`, `req-2045678961-SD`. Logged to incident. Also exporting flamegraph of prompt-hop latency.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-0912 status updated to: mitigated. Owner: maya. Time to mitigate: ~6m from alert.

jordan: handing off formally to maya. Leaving monitoring dashboard pinned. If error_rate rises above 0.08 again, re-open and escalate to eng-runtime.

maya: Accepted handoff. I'll run a 1-hour watch window and then draft the postmortem. Notifying Customer Success to reach out to AcmeAnalytics and SmartDocs with incident summary and mitigation steps.

ekaterina: For the postmortem defers: replicate in staging with v0.9.1 of routing optimizer, add stricter backpressure and better upstream error handling, and add a kill-switch playbook to docs (curl snippet + routectl commands).

jordan: thanks all — nice quick coordination. Closing slack thread once postmortem link available. :white_check_mark:
